correctness.rationale: For odd r, gcd(2^r-1,3)=1; the Kummer normalization is smooth with three totally ramified quotient points. Direct local valuations of (u+1)^v du/z^j produce exactly (k-1)/2 independent holomorphic differentials. Exact Cartier identities yield a partial-permutation graph whose stable rank is the number of complete doubling orbits remaining in I_k. Repeating length-r binary expansions identify those with cyclic words avoiding 00; the transfer-matrix trace is L_r and omitting the all-ones zero residue gives L_r-1. Timpanella Proposition 4.6 doubles this quotient 2-rank. Standalone integer checks reproduce rank formula through odd r=15, but the universal theorem uses the written proof.

value.rationale: Geometric 2-rank is a natural arithmetic invariant of the Jacobian in a recently classified large-automorphism family. The known nonordinary bound leaves an infinite Mersenne series unresolved; the closed Lucas formula completely determines that invariant for every odd exponent and connects its growth to an intrinsic Frobenius rotation on cyclic bit strings. The parameter condition is motivated by the order of doubling modulo 2^r-1, not an arbitrary finite slice. No larger theorem or Newton-polygon claim is asserted.
